authority_scope: Owns the public student setup and installation guide for AI Build Lab workshops, including the Claude-guided setup prompt, deterministic installer beta, migration helpers, and secret-protection checks. It does not own Company Hub catalog routing, private student repositories, course release authority, media, or credentials.
notes: During Company Hub coexistence, Company Hub is the catalog and routing projection for this repository, while Team HQ remains readable and accepts existing work. This repository remains a public student delivery tool and should stay separate. Credentials and secret material stay outside Git; the tracked repository includes secret guard and tripwire tooling. The open hold is to bind installer versions to supported course releases and dependency checks.
